findings.affected_requirement: T015/T016 and release-evidence-contract.md exact command/artifact/case/observation binding requirements
findings.evidence: The validator checks status, ordering, scoring fields, and limited stream metadata but does not resolve command or observation IDs, verify artifact existence or hashes, reject nonzero command exits, or compare corpus/result/receipt/packet-fingerprint sets. A schema-valid passed envelope may therefore claim nonexistent or foreign evidence.
findings.correction_outcome: Add public-seam RED vectors for dangling or foreign command, observation, and artifact references, nonzero exits, altered artifact hashes, and mismatched corpus/result/receipt/packet-fingerprint sets; then minimally enforce those bindings without implementing the deferred T043 runner or Track B/C behavior.

summary: REVISE. Track A preserves authorization, persisted-state isolation, bounded disclosure, resume re-read, scoped DI, and no-migration boundaries, but its release-evidence semantic validator does not yet enforce required cross-record bindings. Focused immutable-boundary tests passed 90/90 but do not cover QR-TA-001.
